export_evidence: No export shipment attributable to this company was found. The only helmet-related customs row on ImportKey is an INBOUND record, not an export: "2024-11-06 | PT.ARTHA PERSADA RAYA | YADAV ENTERPRISES | SHELL NHK GP R TECH STREET-SOLID (COLOUR :BLACK DOFT, S/M/L)(PART OF HELMET) | Indonesia | CHENNAI SEA, India | 65061090 | 3931885" — i.e. helmet shells imported INTO India from Indonesia, HS 65061090, B/L 3931885. The other rows on the same ImportKey page are unrelated goods ("APPLICATOR" HS 82057000, "CONCERTINA COIL BT 012 850 M 150 COIL" HS 73130020) shipped to Nepal via Raxaul/Sonauli, which indicates a conflated name match rather than one verified exporter. Source counter: ImportKey page for "YADAV ENTERPRISES" states "Total Shipments 63 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 5" / "Latest Cargo 2025-03-19", but only 5 rows were actually visible on the free view, and 0 of those 5 are exports of helmets by this company.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report supply split could be located for this entity. Searches for "Cortex Helmets" / "Yadav Tech" returned no usable results (the web_search backend was down: "searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>"), and Volza returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. ImportKey pages for the slug variants "yadav-tech", "yadav-enterprises-cortex-helmets" and "yadav-enterprises-helmet" all rendered with zero shipment rows ("Loading..." / empty tables). No domestic supply record found.
note: Следов поставок не найдено — ни по экспорту, ни по внутреннему рынку. Legal name "YADAV TECH" returns 0 customs records on ImportKey; the "YADAV ENTERPRISES" page that does return data is a name collision (pharma applicators and concertina coil to Nepal), and its single helmet line is an IMPORT of helmet shells from Indonesia (HS 65061090, B/L 3931885, 2024-11-06, Chennai Sea), which is evidence of sourcing, not of supply. Declared HS 650610 is consistent with the helmet-shell import line (65061090) but there is no shipment proving this company sells finished helmets anywhere. Brand "Cortex Helmets" and the claimed industry "Строительство и DIY" (construction/DIY) are website-level claims only — status: заявлено, не подтверждено. Revenue and export volume: null (not public, not invented). No CIN/PAN found. Note: web_search tool was non-functional during this check and Volza blocked (403), so negative findings rest on ImportKey free views only — a paid customs-database pull is needed before treating this as final.
